headline: 885 rate changes since the last refresh (741 up, 144 down)
detail: Biggest move: P&N Bank 9 Month Term Deposit fixed 3.80% → 5.40%.

headline: Westpac leads variable, owner-occupied P&I at 4.99%
detail: Sustainable Upgrades Home Loan (comparison rate 4.99%) is 1.45 pp below the median of 89 lenders (6.44%); 80% LVR. Runner-up: Broken Hill Bank at 5.94%.

headline: Westpac leads variable, investment P&I at 4.99%
detail: Sustainable Upgrades Investment Loan (comparison rate 4.99%) is 1.70 pp below the median of 87 lenders (6.69%); 80% LVR. Runner-up: Northern Inland Credit Union Limited at 5.94%.

headline: BankVic leads 2-year fixed, owner-occupied P&I at 6.09%
detail: Fixed Rate Home Loan - 2 years (comparison rate 6.35%) is 0.50 pp below the median of 78 lenders (6.59%); 80% LVR. Runner-up: gmcu at 6.19%.

headline: Police Credit Union Ltd leads 3-year fixed, owner-occupied P&I at 6.19%
detail: 3 Year Fixed Rate Home Loan 95% LVR - First Home Buyer (comparison rate 7.00%) is 0.48 pp below the median of 73 lenders (6.67%); 80% LVR. Runner-up: Credit Union SA at 6.24%.

headline: The Mac leads variable, investment interest-only at 6.17%
detail: GOVT LOW DEP VARIABLE OOC PI (comparison rate 6.24%) is 0.77 pp below the median of 75 lenders (6.94%); 80% LVR. Runner-up: Horizon Bank at 6.34%.

headline: Heartland leads 6-month term deposit at 5.47%
detail: Broker Term Deposit is 0.37 pp above the median of 48 lenders (5.10%); $10,000 deposit. Runner-up: Australian Military Bank at 5.45%.

headline: Suncorp Bank leads 1-year term deposit at 5.75%
detail: Term Deposit is 0.45 pp above the median of 49 lenders (5.30%); $10,000 deposit. Runner-up: AMP Bank GO at 5.70%.

headline: Maitland Mutual Limited leads savings rate incl. bonus at 4.95%
detail: Mighty Mutual Account is 1.40 pp above the median of 79 lenders (3.55%); $10,000 balance. Runner-up: Beyond Bank Australia at 4.90%.

headline: Bankwest leads credit card purchase rate at 18.99%
detail: Bankwest Zero Platinum Mastercard is 2.00 pp below the median of 23 lenders (20.99%); any annual fee. Runner-up: Bank Australia at 19.74%.

headline: Bendigo Bank leads fixed personal loan at 6.24%
detail: Bendigo Secured Green Personal Loan (comparison rate 6.61%) is 0.75 pp below the median of 49 lenders (6.99%); advertised "from" rate. Runner-up: Greater Bank at 6.24%.

headline: Westpac is cheapest on variable P&I for both owner-occupiers and investors
detail: 4.99% owner-occupied and 4.99% for investors at 80% LVR — an investor premium of 0.00 pp.

headline: Northern Inland Credit Union Limited is cheapest on 1-year fixed P&I for both owner-occupiers and investors
detail: 5.99% owner-occupied and 5.99% for investors at 80% LVR — an investor premium of 0.00 pp.

headline: BankVic is cheapest on 2-year fixed P&I for both owner-occupiers and investors
detail: 6.09% owner-occupied and 6.19% for investors at 80% LVR — an investor premium of 0.10 pp.

headline: 3-year fixed P&I: Police Credit Union Ltd is better if you'll live in the property; CommFCU is better for investors
detail: Owner-occupied: Police Credit Union Ltd 6.19% vs CommFCU 6.29%. Investment: CommFCU 6.39% vs Police Credit Union Ltd 6.39%. At 80% LVR.

headline: Police Credit Union Ltd is cheapest on 5-year fixed P&I for both owner-occupiers and investors
detail: 6.39% owner-occupied and 6.59% for investors at 80% LVR — an investor premium of 0.20 pp.

headline: Investor premium ranges from 0.00 pp (Westpac) to 1.50 pp (Central Murray Bank)
detail: Gap between each lender's best variable P&I investor and owner-occupier rate, 87 lenders. Median premium 0.20 pp. If you're an investor, Westpac penalises you least.

headline: Typical 1-year fixed rate is 0.11 pp above typical variable
detail: Owner-occupied P&I medians across lenders: variable 6.44%; 1-year fixed 6.55%, 2-year fixed 6.59%, 3-year fixed 6.67%, 5-year fixed 6.81%.

headline: Credit Union SA rewards a bigger deposit the most: 0.95 pp cheaper at 60% LVR than 85%
detail: 6.54% at 60% LVR vs 7.49% at 85% (owner-occupied variable P&I). Best at 60% LVR overall: Westpac 4.99%.

headline: An offset account costs at least 1.11 pp extra in rate
detail: Cheapest variable owner-occupied P&I with offset: Gateway Bank 6.10% (Green Plus Home Loan). Cheapest overall: Westpac 4.99%. Weigh the rate gap against your expected offset balance.

headline: Highest term-deposit rate: Suncorp Bank, 1-year at 5.75%
detail: Median 3-month 4.50% vs 5-year 4.00% — shorter terms currently pay more than longer ones. Based on a $10,000 deposit.

headline: Bonus conditions are worth up to 1.55 pp over the best no-strings savings rate
detail: Maitland Mutual Limited pays up to 4.95% (4.50% base + 0.45% bonus: Bonus interest is payable if there are no withdrawals for the month.). Without conditions, Rabobank pays 3.40%.

headline: Lowest card rate isn't fee-free: Bankwest 18.99% vs Bank Australia 12.34% with no annual fee
detail: Bankwest Zero Platinum Mastercard carries about $15 a year in fees. On a balance of $150,000 the two cost about the same per year.

headline: 110 of 115 brands have data-quality issues in their published product data
detail: Most errors: Great Southern Bank (628), Bank of China (145), Credit Union SA (135). See the Data quality report; affected rates may be missing from comparisons.
